title: US State Department selects University of Miami for 2027 Venice Architecture Biennale
excerpt: The university will represent the United States at the 20th Venice Architecture Biennale with an exhibition titled Earth Craft.
bodyHtml:
The U.S. Department of State announced on November 6, 2026, the selection of the University of Miami School of Architecture to represent the United States at the 20th Venice Architecture Biennale.

The exhibition, titled Earth Craft, will be organized by Lead Curator Germane Barnes, who serves as an Associate Professor and Director of the Master of Architecture Graduate Program at the University of Miami School of Architecture and Principal of Studio Barnes.

The exhibition will look at how American architecture is shaped by the land and the people who build on it. It will follow earthen materials, including brick, rammed earth, adobe, and concrete masonry, from the ground to the finished building.

The project will also recognize the brickmakers, masons, and builders who used American soil to build the homes, schools, and public buildings found across the United States. The Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs supports and manages the official U.S. participation at Venice Arts and Architecture Biennales to showcase the excellence of American art and culture on the world stage.
